access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-3.5 Turbo release identified by the dated snapshot gpt-3.5-turbo-0125, announced March 2023. OpenAI announced its deprecation and documents the shutdown date of October 23, 2026 with GPT-5.6 Terra as the recommended replacement. The later GPT-4o and GPT-5 family lines, the OpenAI platform, and ChatGPT remain separate product or service boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents the pinned snapshot, deprecation date, and recommended replacement first-party
Chat Completions, Responses API, and fine-tuning are documented endpoints
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
Access ends at the documented shutdown date
